## Summary

Describe the pipeline, delivery, or documentation change.

## Reviewer Focus

- [ ] The change reduces a clear delivery risk.
- [ ] Credentials and secrets remain protected.
- [ ] Artifacts, logs, or release evidence are easier to review.

## Validation

- [ ] Jenkinsfile syntax or examples were reviewed.
- [ ] Documentation explains operational trade-offs.
- [ ] The change is easy to discuss in an interview.

## Portfolio Signal

Explain what this PR makes stronger for a technical interview.
